summary: preinstall script exfiltrates host and CI metadata to attacker-controlled oastify.com subdomain
details: package.json declares a preinstall script that runs `node -e` inline JavaScript on npm install. The inline code collects the installer's hostname, username, current working directory, npm registry configuration, CI environment markers (CI, GITHUB_REPOSITORY, JENKINS_URL), and platform, base64-encodes the JSON, and sends it as an HTTPS GET query parameter to `9u4hlcu3febavvzbrqulpuwf66cy0qof.oastify.com`, a Burp Collaborator out-of-band exfiltration endpoint. The package name resembles the legitimate `pdfjs-dist` package and the version number `99.9.9` is a dependency-confusion pattern intended to outrank an internal package of the same name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
